links.outcome: Concordance of AI PD-L1 scoring with expert pathologist reference
links.effect: Binary concordance 95.2% (κ=0.89); three-tier concordance 94.5% (weighted κ=0.93); category changes in 6% (20/333) of cases.
links.quote: The overall concordance of PD-L1 status (cutoff ≥1%) between the uPath algorithm and the pathologist was 95.2% (κ = 0.89), while the concordance for the three-tier categorization was 94.5% (weighted κ = 0.93).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic concordance and potential clinical impact (immunotherapy eligibility) of an AI image analysis algorithm compared to an expert pathologist for PD-L1 scoring in NSCLC, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
